title: Latency-aware ranking evaluation harness and customer prompt curation
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build an evaluation harness that jointly measures ranking quality (NDCG/MRR) and request-level latency to inform model selection and rollout policies. The harness will support ingesting customer prompt sets, synthetic perturbations (typos, truncation, query expansion), and a latency-aware scoring function that penalizes high tail latency during A/B experiments. Deliverables: telemetry instrumentation, batch eval jobs, a Looker/Grafana dashboard, and A/B hook integration for canary rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: NDCG and MRR are computed per-promptset and exported to metrics pipeline with tags: model, variant, customer_segment, perturbation
Latency distribution (p50/p90/p99) is joined to quality metrics for every experiment and visible in the dashboard
A latency-aware score is defined and implemented: quality_score - alpha * normalized_99_latency (configurable alpha)
Customer prompt ingestion API accepts anonymized prompt sets with explicit consent flag and stores provenance metadata
A/B hook exists to route X% of traffic to new reranker variant and emit joint metrics for at least 7 days
Automated nightly batch evals run on representative customer slices and push regression alerts if latency-weighted score drops by >2%
